tricks: Coaches are real dancers filmed in full costume and make-up on green screen, then stylised in post: video, not rigged animation
Pictograms scroll along the bottom to show the next move; the player is scored by the controller (or a phone camera with a trained model)
motion.lesson: When the dance must be perfect, film or capture a real performer; mirror the player and rate every move without failing them.
